Page 1 Controls There are two pages of controls for each VCO. You have just accessed the first page. The top display in the page modifier section shows the names of the controls, which are from left:

oo —— —— rrr _ ~

FREQ DETUNE LL vot SWITCH MODE | TT TTL | ot 0 3) 63 SWITCH MODE CO - ro oo ow OO dO © A © O so

FREQ / The frequency of the oscillator in semitones. DETUNE / The fine tuning of the oscillator sharp or flat. PW / Pulse width of the pulse wave output of the oscillator.

VOL ; The output volume of the oscillator.

Modulation The frequency, pulse width, and volume of the oscillator can be modulated by other sources. See the section on Modulation Pages.
